title: 煅玉堂 第八十一章 连云秘境煅玉堂 第八十章 无知无畏
content_zh:
“窦德真仙也会进入秘境。不知秘境中是否准许争斗？”
秦凤鸣转身，立即见到了一位不愿见到的熟人，后背冰寒显现，他口中立即询问出声。
汤巍真仙转头，也看到了窦德真仙，眉头微是皱起。
“连云城秘境并不限制争斗，但里面限制飞遁，就是真仙都无法飞遁空中。并且进入后，会胡乱散布。无论是大乘、仙境还是金仙、真仙，都会随意传送。要想找寻一人极为不易。除非恰好传送一起。”
董迁开口，对这里秘境早有了解，详细解释。
“不用担心，秘境极为广袤，没有人丈量过，但想来也有数十万里方圆，不能飞遁，要想找寻一人，几乎是不可能的事。因为进入其中有时间限制，只有半年而已，如不立即施术淬炼己身，到最后未必能够获得好处。”六竺真仙开口，纾解了秦凤鸣心中担心。
如此大一个秘境，修士不能飞遁，要想寻找一人，没有数年时间，根本就做不到。
秦凤鸣转头看向怒目而视的窦德真仙，脸上浮现出现笑意，一副嘲讽之意。
只要他不衰运当头，点背正好与窦德真仙传送到了一起，秦凤鸣确定窦德不会浪费时间到处找寻他。
窦德真仙怒视秦凤鸣，但他无可奈何。连云城有道君大能坐镇，他哪怕是魔阴宫核心弟子，也不敢在连云城中动手擒拿秦凤鸣。
不只是窦德满脸怒意，就是他身旁的两位金仙，也是瞪视秦凤鸣，咬牙切齿。
见秦凤鸣挑衅一位真仙，两位金仙，汤巍真仙一阵无言。这个青年修士真不让人省心。换做其他仙境，别说敢对一位真仙如此所为，就是不敬也没有谁敢当面显露。
户亮金仙见到众人，立即到了众人面前。他一直没有露面，想来是在真仙面前感觉拘束，自己找寻了一处所在闭关了。
太阳正午时，三位真仙自远处飞射而来，停身在了广场上的高大石台之上。石台呈现六边形，六个角处有一尊高大的黝黑巨鼎耸立。
三人看向四周群修，满意点点头。
“各位，今日是我连云城秘境开启之日，这次人数不少，竟有千多人。很是不错。各位如果想进入秘境，就将三千仙灵石随意置入六尊巨鼎，然后领取一枚秘境玉牌，否则是无法进入秘境的。进入其中，会随机传送，里面没有凶兽，不用各位警惕。半年后，玉牌会带着各位传送出秘境。好了，各位可以开始了。”
一位真仙扫过众人，满脸笑意的开口。一千多人，那就是三百多万仙灵石，哪怕开启秘境需要花费不少仙灵石，但连云城也会余下不少。
众人纷纷登上石台，将各自仙灵石交给负责修士，然后领取玉牌。
“进入秘境，要慢慢祭出材料，千万不能祭出太多，否则会引动恐怖之力袭身，可能会有陨落危险。”六竺真仙看向蓝冰，开口叮嘱道。
蓝冰点头，神情凝重。

“走吧，我们去领取玉牌。”芦湛真仙开口，向着石台飞去。
一千多位修士散布，倒也遮蔽了很大一片区域。随着最后一位修士仙灵石交出，三位真仙开始施术。
很快，三股流光自三人身前显现，相互交织下，如同水波自三人身上荡漾开来，恐怖能量如同浩瀚江河喷涌。能量充斥的波光与六尊巨鼎触碰，猛然发出六声震耳的嗡鸣。
六道犹如实质般的浩荡仙灵能量蕴含的光柱猛然从六尊巨鼎之上冲击而出，直向高空而去。
突然间，高空中好像一个巨大的无形之物被六道光柱击中，波光喷散而开，顷刻遮蔽了浩瀚虚空。
content_en:
"Zhenxian Dou De will also enter the secret realm. I wonder if fighting is allowed in the secret realm?"
Qin Fengming turned around and immediately saw an acquaintance he didn't want to see. Ice cold appeared on his back, and he immediately asked.
Immortal Tang Wei turned around and saw Immortal Dou De, frowning slightly.
"Lianyun City's secret realm does not restrict fighting, but it does restrict flying. Even true immortals cannot fly in the air. And after entering, they will be scattered randomly. Whether it is Mahayana, fairyland, golden immortal, or true immortal, they will be teleported at will. It is extremely difficult to find someone. Unless they happen to be teleported together."
Dong Qian opened his mouth. He already knew about the secret place here and explained it in detail.
"Don't worry, the secret realm is extremely vast and no one has ever measured it, but it is estimated to be hundreds of thousands of miles in radius and cannot be flown away. It is almost impossible to find someone. Because there is a time limit to enter it, it is only half a year. If you don't use magic to temper your body immediately, you may not be able to reap the benefits in the end." Liuzhu True Immortal spoke, allaying Qin Fengming's worries.
In such a large secret realm, monks cannot fly. If they want to find someone, they will not be able to do it without a few years.
Qin Fengming turned to look at the glaring Immortal Dou De, with a smile on his face, a look of ridicule.
As long as he is not unlucky and happens to be teleported together with the True Immortal Dou De, Qin Fengming is sure that Dou De will not waste time looking for him.
Immortal Dou De glared at Qin Fengming, but there was nothing he could do. There is a powerful Dao Lord in Lianyun City. Even if he is a core disciple of Moyin Palace, he would not dare to capture Qin Fengming in Lianyun City.
Not only Dou De's face was full of anger, but the two golden immortals beside him also stared at Qin Fengming and gritted their teeth.
Seeing Qin Fengming provoking a true immortal and two golden immortals, True Immortal Tang Wei was speechless for a while. This young monk is really worrying. In any other fairyland, no one would dare to do this to a true immortal, even if they were disrespectful, no one would dare to show it to his face.
When Hu Liangjinxian saw the crowd, he immediately came in front of them. He never showed up. He probably felt awkward in front of the real immortal, so he found a place to retreat.
At noon, three true immortals flew from a distance and stopped on the tall stone platform in the square. The stone platform is hexagonal, with a tall dark giant cauldron standing at the six corners.
The three of them looked at the surrounding cultivators and nodded with satisfaction.
"Everyone, today is the day when I open the secret realm of Lianyun City. There are quite a few people this time. There are more than a thousand people. It's very good. If you want to enter the secret realm, you can put three thousand immortal spirit stones into the six giant cauldrons at will, and then receive a secret realm jade token. Otherwise, you will not be able to enter the secret realm. Enter it and you will be teleported randomly. There are no ferocious beasts in it, so you don't need to be vigilant. After half a year, the jade token will take you out of the secret realm. Okay, everyone can start."
A true immortal glanced at the crowd and spoke with a smile on his face. With more than a thousand people, that means more than three million fairy spirit stones. Even if it takes a lot of fairy spirit stones to open the secret realm, Lianyun City will still have a lot left over.
Everyone climbed onto the stone platform one after another, handed their fairy stones to the monk in charge, and then received the jade plaque.
"When you enter the secret realm, you must slowly sacrifice the materials. Don't sacrifice too much, otherwise it will trigger a terrifying force and may lead to the danger of death." Liuzhu True Immortal looked at Lan Bing and warned.
Lan Bing nodded with a solemn expression.
"Let's go, let's go get the jade token." Immortal Lu Zhan said and flew towards the stone platform.
More than a thousand monks spread out, covering a large area. As the last monk handed over the immortal spirit stone, the three true immortals began to perform spells.
Soon, three streams of light appeared in front of the three people, intertwining with each other, like water waves rippling from the three people, and terrifying energy gushing out like a vast river. The energy-filled waves touched the six giant cauldrons, and suddenly made six ear-splitting buzzes.
The six beams of light contained in the vast and substantial fairy energy suddenly burst from the six giants.The impact came out of the cauldron and went straight into the sky.
Suddenly, it seemed as if a huge invisible object high in the sky was hit by six beams of light. The waves of light spread out, instantly covering the vast void.
